# ageproR

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

ageproR is a developing R-package designed to handle input data to and from 
AGEPRO (Age Structured Projection Model) calculation engine. 

> [!IMPORTANT]
>
> **If you using AGEPRO for production, please use:**
>
> - [AGEPRO-GUI, includes binary for AGEPRO calculation engine](https://github.com/nmfs-ost/AGEPRO-GUI)
> - [AGEPRO Command Line based Calculation Engine source code repo](https://github.com/noaa-pifsc/AGEPRO) 
> 

## Note

**ageproR** is still in development. These features will be implemented in future updates. 

- Predictor Recruitment Models 
- Fixed Recruitment Model 
- Empirical Cumulative Distribution Factor for w/ Linear Decline to Zero
- Markov Matrix Recruitment Model
- ~~Run AGEPRO models with the AGEPRO calculation engine within R.~~
- ~~Exported AGEPRO output R data objects.~~

Importing Stock Synthesis Report Data will handled as a separate R-package project: ss3agepro

## AGEPRO input file format

**ageproR** is compatible with the AGEPRO input file formats 
`AGEPRO VERSION 4.0` & `AGEPRO VERSION 4.25`. By default, **ageproR** saves AGEPRO 
input files in the `AGEPRO VERSION 4.25` format.

Loading an input file with the `AGEPRO VERSION 4.0` format to **ageproR** will maintain its version format
until it is saved (or launched to AGEPRO calcuation engine) in the `AGEPRO VERSION 4.25` format.

**Models sent to the AGEPRO calualtion engine MUST be in the `AGEPRO VERSION 4.25` fornat**

Please refer to the [*AGEPRO Reference Manual*](https://nmfs-ost.github.io/agepro-ref-manual/) for more technical details.

## Installation

You can install ageproR from the [NOAA Fisheries OST Repository](https://github.com/nmfs-ost/ageproR) 
with:

```{r ageproR-install}
#| eval: false

# via `pak`
install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("nmfs-ost/ageproR")

# alternative method
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("nmfs-ost/ageproR")
```

## Configuring ageproR with the AGEPRO calcuation engine

ageproR requires the command line based [AGEPRO Calculation Engine](https://github.com/noaa-pifsc/AGEPRO) to
run model projections. Download the [AGEPRO calculation engine binary](https://github.com/noaa-pifsc/AGEPRO/releases) at the NOAA-PIFSC github repository. 

Store the AGEPRO calcuation engine binary to a folder location, this will be the directory path used to connect ageproR with AGEPRO with each model launch. For convenience, you can set an user-level R envrionmental variable.

### Open `.Renviron` file

The following command will allow you to set the AGEPRO path to your user-level .Renviron file. This command opens 
`~/.Renviron` file in your editor.

```{r use-renvrion}
#| eval: false

usethis::edit_r_environ()
```

### Set the `AGEPRO_PATH` value and save `.Renviron`

> [!WARNING]
> 
> **Windows Paths:** You must use forward slashes (`/`) or double backslashes (`\\`), not the standard single Windows backslashes (`\`).

In `.Renviron`, add the line `AGEPRO_PATH`, with your directory. Save the changes. 

```
AGEPRO_PATH="C://path//to//folder//AGEPRO.EXE"
```

### Restart R and Verify 

**You must restart the R session** for the changes to make effect. Once R is restarted, load `ageproR`. If set correctly, you will see an confirmation message:

```
library(ageproR)
#>'AGEPRO_PATH' found at: "C://path//to//folder//AGEPRO.EXE"
```

```{r example-run, child="inst/extdata/doc-model-workflow.Rmd"}
```

## Citation

Please cite AGEPRO as: 

```
Brodziak, Jon and Rago, Paul J. and Conser, Ramon. (1998). A General Approach for Making Short-Term 
Stochastic Projections from an Age-Structured Fisheries Assessment Model. Fishery Stock Assessment 
Models, 933–954. https://doi.org/10.4027/fsam.1998.52

```
The following [BibTeX](http://www.bibtex.org/) entry can be copied and used in a .bib file:

```bibtex
@article{article,
author = {Brodziak, Jon and Rago, Paul J. and Conser, Ramon},
year = {1998},
month = {01},
pages = {933-954},
title = {A General Approach for Making Short-Term Stochastic Projections from an Age-Structured Fisheries Assessment Model},
isbn = {9781566120579},
doi = {10.4027/fsam.1998.52}
}
```
